_comment: Source words a dictionary column lacks, each attached to an existing Interslavic entry (named by lemma, part of speech and English gloss). No Interslavic word is added. Read by packages/lexicon/src/reader.ts (applySupplement); a row matching no entry is an error.

words.why: the railway station; the same entry's Russian column lists 'вокзал'
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'вокза́л ... train station, railroad station, railway station'; dictionary: stancija, ru 'станция, вокзал'

words.why: the everyday word for 'book', of which 'книга' (the entry's Ukrainian gloss) is the elevated synonym
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'кни́жка ... book. Synonym: (elevated) кни́га'; dictionary: kniga, uk 'книга'

words.why: a male cousin; the entry's Russian column lists 'кузен', its Ukrainian only 'двоюрідний брат'
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'кузе́н ... (dated) male cousin. Synonym: двою́рідний брат'; dictionary: kuzen, ru 'двоюродный брат, кузен'

words.why: 'much, far' with a comparative, the Ukrainian of Russian 'гораздо', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'набага́то ... much, far (+ comparative adjective or adverb)'; dictionary: duže, ru 'много, гораздо'

words.why: the perfective 'to build', a synonym of 'побудувати', which this perfective entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'збудува́ти ... pf (imperfective будува́ти) to build, to construct'; dictionary: sbudovati v.tr. pf., uk 'побудувати', ru 'построить'

words.why: 'to go for a walk'. The dictionary has only the imperfective 'гуляти' = prohoditi sę, so the perfective takes it
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'погуля́ти ... pf (imperfective гуля́ти) to go for a walk, to take a walk, to stroll for a while'; dictionary: prohoditi sę, uk 'гуляти, проходжуватися, прогулюватися'

words.why: 'to stay, to remain'. The entry's own Ukrainian cell reads 'залишитися. зостатися' - a period where its separator should be - so the gloss never matched, and the verb fell back to `ostaviti` 'leave' plus a clitic: 'On ostavil se doma'
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'залиши́тися ... pf (imperfective залиша́тися) to remain, to stay'; dictionary: ostati v.intr. pf., ru 'остаться', uk 'залишитися. зостатися'

words.why: 'to stay, to remain', the shorter synonym of 'залишитися'
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'лиши́тися ... pf (imperfective лиша́тися or залиша́тися) to stay, to remain'; dictionary: ostati v.intr. pf., ru 'остаться'

words.why: 'to leave', a synonym of 'залишити', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'лиши́ти ... pf to leave ... Synonyms: поки́нути, залиши́ти'; dictionary: ostaviti v.tr. pf., uk 'залишити, кинути, покинути'

words.why: 'to see each other, to meet' - the perfective reciprocal 'зустрітися', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'поба́читися ... pf to see each other, to meet'; dictionary: strěsti sę v.refl. pf., uk 'зустрітися', ru 'встретиться'

words.why: 'to tell, to narrate', the Ukrainian of Russian 'рассказать', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'розказа́ти ... pf to tell, to narrate, to recount ... Synonyms: розповісти́'; dictionary: råzkazati v.tr. pf., ru 'рассказать', uk 'розповісти'

words.why: 'to be late', a synonym of 'запізнитися', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'спізни́тися ... pf to be late. Synonym: запізни́тися'; dictionary: opozdniti sę v.refl. pf., uk 'запізнитися'

words.why: 'sad, saddened', a synonym of 'сумний', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'засму́чений ... sad, saddened, sorry, grieved'; dictionary: smųtny adj., uk 'сумний', ru 'печальный, грустный'

words.why: 'to study; to learn', the imperfective 'учитися', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'навча́тися ... impf to study ... to learn'; dictionary: učiti sę v.refl. ipf., uk 'учитися, вчитися', ru 'учиться'

words.why: 'to wait'. The dictionary has only the imperfective, which glosses 'чекати', so the perfective takes it
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'зачека́ти ... pf (imperfective чека́ти) to wait'; dictionary: čekati v.intr. ipf., uk 'чекати, ждати'

words.why: 'infrequently, rarely', a synonym of 'рідко', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'неча́сто ... infrequently, not often, rarely. Synonym: рі́дко'; dictionary: rědko adv., uk 'рідко'

words.why: 'not one, not any' - the full form of 'жоден', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'жо́дний ... not one, not any. Synonym: нія́кий'; dictionary: nijedin pron.indef., uk 'жоден', ru 'ни один, никакой'

words.why: 'so, hence', a synonym of 'отже', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'тож ... so, hence (consequently). Synonym: о́тже'; dictionary: tomu adv., uk 'тому, отже', ru 'поэтому'

words.why: 'even; as much as', the Ukrainian of Russian 'аж', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'аж ... even, as much as; till, until'; dictionary: až adv., ru 'даже, аж'

words.why: 'upright piano', a kind of 'фортепіано', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'піані́но ... upright piano. Hypernym: фортепіа́но'; dictionary: fortepiano n., uk 'фортепіано'

words.why: 'forced, compelled', a synonym of 'вимушений', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'зму́шений ... forced, compelled, constrained'; dictionary: prinuđeny adj., uk 'вимушений', ru 'вынужденный'

words.why: 'good', a synonym of 'добрий', which this entry glosses (its Russian column has 'хороший')
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'хоро́ший ... good. Synonyms: до́брий, га́рний'; dictionary: dobry adj., uk 'добрий', ru 'хороший, добрый'

words.why: the imperfective 'to be late', a synonym of 'спізнюватися', which this entry glosses
words.evidence: Wiktionary: 'запі́знюватися ... impf (perfective запізни́тися) to be late. Synonyms: спі́знюватися'; dictionary: opozdnjati sę v.refl. ipf., uk 'спізнюватися, затримуватися'
